parameters: \rDid you come to pay your respect\nto the spirits of departed Pokémon?
\rYou must care for your Pokémon a lot.
\bThis is the final resting place of my\nZigzagoon. I cherished it…
\rAll sorts of beings wander the slopes\nof Mt. Pyre…
\rThere is no telling what may happen.\nTake this. It's for your own good.
\rIt will help ward off wild Pokémon.
